$comment: Era base for Formula 1 2010-2013: the last 2.4 V8 years, the Vettel and Red Bull titles. Every season in seasons/ with "base": "f1-v8" builds on it (tools/layers.py): rules, Pirelli tyres, traced tracks. 2010 (Bridgestone, no DRS, no KERS) overrides what differs in its own season folder. The vanilla game is a modern F1 manager, so the base pack's economy and car scale fit almost unchanged.
title: F1 2010-2013 (era base)
